Name: Style
Description: Selects the overall appearance and shaping method for the crater.

Flubs.Name: New
Flubs.Description: Uses the modern crater generation algorithm, producing more realistic and detailed crater shapes.

Flubs.Name: Classic
Flubs.Description: Applies the legacy crater style, creating traditional, stylized crater forms.

Name: Scale
Description: Controls the overall size of the crater. Higher values produce larger craters.

Name: Formation
Description: Determines the formation characteristics of the crater, such as depth, width, and rim prominence.

Name: Height
Description: Sets the maximum elevation or prominence of the crater above the base terrain.

Name: Rim
Description: Specifies the sharpness and profile of the crater's rim.

Flubs.Name: Soft
Flubs.Description: Creates a gently sloping, eroded rim for a more weathered appearance.

Flubs.Name: Sharp
Flubs.Description: Produces a steep, well-defined rim for a freshly formed or less eroded crater.

Name: Shape
Description: Defines the overall outline and contour of the crater, such as roundness or irregularity.

Name: X
Description: Horizontal placement of the crater or crater field within the terrain.

Name: Y
Description: Vertical placement of the crater or crater field within the terrain.

Name: Seed
Description: The randomization pattern or seed for the node's process. Changing the seed produces different crater variations.
